mapper.select: SELECT n.id AS news_id, n.title AS title, n.url AS url, n.published_at AS published_at, na.summary AS summary, na.importance_score AS importance_score, string_agg(DISTINCT ni.industry, ',') AS industries_csv FROM news n JOIN news_analysis na ON na.news_id = n.id LEFT JOIN news_industry ni ON ni.news_id = n.id WHERE COALESCE(n.published_at, n.collected_at)::date = #{date} GROUP BY n.id, n.title, n.url, n.published_at, na.summary, na.importance_score ORDER BY na.importance_score DESC LIMIT #{limit}

WITH tier1_ranked AS ( SELECT n.id AS news_id, n.title AS title, n.url AS url, n.published_at AS published_at, na.summary AS summary, na.importance_score AS importance_score, string_agg(DISTINCT ni.industry, ',') AS industries_csv, ja.job AS job, ja.why_it_matters AS why_it_matters, ja.key_skills AS key_skills, ja.importance_score AS job_importance_score, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ja.importance_score DESC) AS rn FROM news n JOIN news_analysis na ON na.news_id = n.id JOIN news_job_analysis ja ON ja.news_id = n.id AND ja.job = #{job} LEFT JOIN news_industry ni ON ni.news_id = n.id WHERE COALESCE(n.published_at, n.collected_at)::date = #{date} AND ja.importance_score >= #{minJobScore} GROUP BY n.id, n.title, n.url, n.published_at, na.summary, na.importance_score, ja.job, ja.why_it_matters, ja.key_skills, ja.importance_score ), tier1 AS ( SELECT news_id, title, url, published_at, summary, importance_score, industries_csv, job, why_it_matters, key_skills, job_importance_score FROM tier1_ranked WHERE rn <= #{limit} ), tier1_count AS ( SELECT count(*) AS cnt FROM tier1 ), tier2_ranked AS ( SELECT n.id AS news_id, n.title AS title, n.url AS url, n.published_at AS published_at, na.summary AS summary, na.importance_score AS importance_score, string_agg(DISTINCT ni.industry, ',') AS industries_csv, ja.job AS job, ja.why_it_matters AS why_it_matters, ja.key_skills AS key_skills, ja.importance_score AS job_importance_score, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY na.importance_score DESC) AS rn FROM news n JOIN news_analysis na ON na.news_id = n.id JOIN news_job_analysis ja ON ja.news_id = n.id AND ja.job = #{job} LEFT JOIN news_industry ni ON ni.news_id = n.id WHERE COALESCE(n.published_at, n.collected_at)::date = #{date} AND n.id NOT IN (SELECT news_id FROM tier1) GROUP BY n.id, n.title, n.url, n.published_at, na.summary, na.importance_score, ja.job, ja.why_it_matters, ja.key_skills, ja.importance_score ), tier2 AS ( SELECT t.news_id, t.title, t.url, t.published_at, t.summary, t.importance_score, t.industries_csv, t.job, t.why_it_matters, t.key_skills, t.job_importance_score FROM tier2_ranked t, tier1_count WHERE t.rn <= (#{limit} - tier1_count.cnt) ), combined AS ( SELECT news_id, title, url, published_at, summary, importance_score, industries_csv, job, why_it_matters, key_skills, job_importance_score, true AS is_job_highlighted FROM tier1 UNION ALL SELECT news_id, title, url, published_at, summary, importance_score, industries_csv, job, why_it_matters, key_skills, job_importance_score, false AS is_job_highlighted FROM tier2 )
SELECT * FROM combined ORDER BY is_job_highlighted DESC, CASE WHEN is_job_highlighted THEN job_importance_score ELSE importance_score END DESC
